name: solana-security-standard
description: Scan Solana/Anchor code against the Solana Security Standard and serve its 52-rule ruleset to any MCP client.
long_description: The Solana Security Standard MCP server gives any MCP-compatible assistant two read-only tools: scan a Solana/Anchor Rust snippet against the open Solana Security Standard (52 numbered SOL-0XX rules) for fast advisory findings, and fetch the full ruleset (threat model, review checklist, and every rule with its fix) to write or review on-chain code safely. Zero dependencies, fully local: code never leaves your machine. Source: github.com/Copenhagen0x/solana-security-standard.

tools.name: scan_solana_code
tools.description: Scan a snippet of Solana/Anchor Rust against the Solana Security Standard (SOL-0XX) fast patterns. Returns advisory findings.

tools.name: list_solana_security_rules
tools.description: Return the full Solana Security Standard guidance: threat model, review checklist, and all 52 rules with fixes.
